comment: C-first source-verified case for dog.c:abuse_dog -> apply.c:m_unleash(TRUE). A neutral Wizard creates a tame baby gray dragon (C initedog minimum tame 5), wishes a leash, attaches it to the pet north, then kicks the thick-skinned pet five times with the C-observed adjacent-square pattern. The fifth abuse sets mtame to zero; C displays that the dragon pulls free of its leash and clears the attachment.
